title: Wooftop Wednesdays
description: Bring the dog. Two-for-one drinks all day at the Sunset Bar, and every truck runs a $5 item your dog can order. Excludes flights.

title: Bingo Night
description: Every Wednesday from 7pm to 9pm. Gift card prizes, including a progressive jackpot that grows every week. Whether you are a Bingo enthusiast or just looking for a fun midweek activity, this is the way to unwind.

title: Ross Brown
description: Live music on the rooftop every Thursday evening, 6 to 8, at the Sunset Bar.

title: La Noche · DJ David Cast
description: Saturdays turn late. DJ David Cast takes the rooftop from 10pm until 2am.
